heading: Upload Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR)
paragraphs: Upload a copy of the Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR).
beforeUploadText: Give your document a name that explains what it is. For example, 'Receipt of payment from Jane Smith'
uploadHint: You can upload a PDF, Word (DOCX) or Excel (XLSX) file. Each file must be smaller than 20MB.
